customManagers.description: CI pins zizmor inline (pipx run zizmor==X); the pre-commit manager cannot see it.

packageRules.description: Keep the inline CI pin and the pre-commit hook in one PR so they never drift.

The native reference of the LZ4 tests and benchmarks: lz4 1.10.0, whose bytes the managed compressors write. NativeCompressions.LZ4 1.3.0 ships lz4 1.11.0, whose bytes differ at every level (#7), so it stays below 1.3.0 until the compressors follow 1.11.0 deliberately. NativeCompressions.Zstandard moves on its own: 1.1.0 to 1.3.0 all ship zstd 1.5.7.
